source_information: Only sampled GTFS-RT receipts at or before the prediction clock. Peer summaries contain at most one current departure forecast per other trip. Actual endpoints are used for training before calibration and scoring after a prediction.
distribution_model: Smoothed empirical route/event-kind delay and issued-forecast error laws, with route counts shrunk toward the corresponding pooled event-kind law. Public peer shift changes location. The convex own-forecast mixture weight is fitted on the parameter-training dates only.
interval_calibration: Each calibration day contributes its empirical 90th-percentile endpoint interval nonconformity. The rank-nine day quantile supplies a nonnegative additive envelope correction for each fixed model.
selection: No method, parameter or interval target is selected by performance on the three already examined held-out dates. Their readout is a development reevaluation. A further untouched date is required for an independent benefit claim.
